meta.name: pyqt-theme-and-icons-pack
meta.description: Standardize visual assets and theme loading with qrc/qss conventions. Use when UI styling is fragmented or hardcoded.

copy.tagline: 统一管理 PyQt 主题与图标资源
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 PyQt 应用界面样式分散、难以维护
copy.tagline_en: Standardize PyQt theme and icon assets
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your PyQt app's UI styling is fragmented and hard to maintain

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照 qrc/qss 规范统一管理 PyQt 应用的视觉资源（图标、主题），并生成资源文件、样式变量策略以及 DPI/字体回退指南。
howto.when: 当用户要求标准化 PyQt 界面样式，或现有样式分散、硬编码时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 qrc/qss 规范整理这个 PyQt 项目的图标和主题。
say.note: Claude 会读取项目文件并生成资源文件。

say.text: 为我的 PyQt 应用生成 DPI 和字体回退指南。
say.note: Claude 会输出相关配置建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will manage PyQt visual assets (icons, themes) using qrc/qss conventions, producing resource files, style variable policies, and DPI/font fallback guidance.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to standardize PyQt UI styling, or when existing styles are fragmented or hardcoded.

say_en.text: Help me organize icons and themes for this PyQt project using qrc/qss conventions.
say_en.note: Claude will read project files and generate resource files.

say_en.text: Generate DPI and font fallback guidance for my PyQt app.
say_en.note: Claude will output relevant configuration suggestions.
